name: Barrow Trench
summary: The Barrow Trench is a mine in northwestern Greenshade, north of Moonhenge containing bandits. A skyshard is located east of the delve, along the base of the cliff. They are mining ore throughout and are led by Overseer Basri. There is a camp with a cooking fire outside the delve. There is a Delivery Contract at the delve's entrance that grants the related quest. A note lies on the picnic table in the center of the northern chamber. The delve's boss is located atop a wooden platform in the southern side of the southwestern chamber. The delve's skyshard is located outside the one-way exit outside the eastern side of the southwestern chamber. Rats are found in number within.
